_note: English caption -> Tamil, written as people speak it (owner: spoken Tamil, not formal written Tamil). The same text is the caption and the voice (see record.js and voice-import.js). English screen terms stay in English letters (PetroMath, Transactions, ledger); Tamil endings can be joined with a hyphen (file-ஐ, account-க்கு). Prefer பண்ணுங்க to பண்ணிக்கோங்க (sounds non-native in this voice).
